title: 第26章 谁都别想好过！
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
转眼又过去两天。

    午后风和日丽，天清气爽。

    院墙上几株老藤蔓在微风里轻轻摇晃，将细碎的影子投在青石地面上，像一幅变幻的水墨画。

    齐云溪买来一张竹躺椅，铺上厚厚的软垫，将苏牧转移到院子里晒太阳。

    换药从计划的三天一次改成了每天一换，一日三餐各种滋补营养汤食，在齐云溪的精心照顾下，短短不到十天，苏牧的伤势便有了明显的好转。

    虽然还无法下床行动自如，却可以初步活动手脚，比如端杯喝个茶，自己完全可以做到，无需再由他人代劳喂到嘴边。

    此刻，苏牧心情明朗，躺在懒人椅上，悠闲地品着香茗，看天空云卷云舒，赏庭院一草一木。

    日光从桑树的枝叶间漏下来，洒在身上暖洋洋的，风也是软的，裹着花草和泥土的清气，一阵一阵地拂过脸颊。

    齐云溪从屋里抱出一床全新的被褥搭在晾衣绳上，展开，抚平，隔着被子轻轻拍了两下，动作利落而专注。

    随后，她去到水井旁，挽起袖子打水，提着木桶、拿着抹布去擦洗连廊的栏杆和门框，水声哗哗，夹着她偶尔哼起的小调，听不清词，但调子轻快悦耳。

    打扫完卫生，她又去到厨房，端着菜篮返回水井旁坐下择菜清洗，玉指翻飞间，枯叶和根蒂落入脚边的竹篓里……

    每次从躺椅旁经过，齐云溪都朝男人投去笑脸，眉眼弯弯，弧度正适，让人如沐春风。

    苏牧看着她忙碌的身影在庭院里来回穿梭，满怀惬意，脑海里不禁冒出念头，只觉得这样的日子挺好，即便今后不修行了，这般安享余生似乎也不错。

    只是，念头刚起，便被按了下去。

    苏牧很清楚，实力才是根本，弱肉强食在远比凡俗社会复杂的修行界，体现得更为明显。

    眼前的这份安宁是短暂的，也有运气和侥幸。

    李构的命，执法殿的鞭子，聂无极的人情，林语山的仓皇远遁……一步踏错，今天头顶这片树荫就得易主。

    他端起茶杯抿了一口，目光越过院墙，落在远处青云山脉层叠的峰峦上，山还是那座山，云还是那片云，自己只是暂时在树荫下歇脚，歇够了还得往前走，一路向前。

    不知不觉间，夕阳斜照，晚霞为院子披上了一层碎金纱衣，桑树的影子被拉得很长，一直伸到连廊的台阶。

    轻微的脚步声传来，一道高大魁梧的身影出现在长廊上。

    苏牧偏头瞧去，嘴角浮现一丝笑意，招呼道：“来了。”

    楚阳扫视一圈没见到齐云溪，身型一晃两个起落便到了面前。

    他挥手将水井旁的小木凳拘禁到躺椅旁坐下，随口问：“齐师妹出门了？”

    苏牧偏头示意了下道：“在里边。”

    楚阳微微颔首，自己从案几上的盘子里翻了个空杯，倒了杯灵茶，端在手里却不喝，只是慢悠悠地转着杯子。

    苏牧对他何其了解，眨眨眼问：“吞吞吐吐的，什么事？”

    楚阳朝里屋瞥去一眼，挥手布了个隔绝护罩，才道：“南初姐明早走。”

    苏牧微怔，轻轻点头道：“她跟我说过离宗的事，让你来当说客？”

    楚阳在对方脸上瞧了瞧，犹豫斟酌了下措辞，说道：“大哥，南初姐对你的心意无需我多说，你又对她知根知底，绝对信得过，你二人最是般配，为何不留下她？”

    不等回应，他接着又道：“眼下形势一片大好，这宅子足够大，多个人住也无妨，南初姐那边我去说，做个妾室，想来，她生生气，发发牢骚也能接受，至于齐师妹，性子比较软，对你又上心，应该不会拒绝的。”
content_en:
Two days passed in the blink of an eye.

    The afternoon was sunny and windy, and the sky was refreshing.

    Several old vines on the courtyard wall sway gently in the breeze, casting tiny shadows on the bluestone ground, like a changing ink painting.

    Qi Yunxi bought a bamboo lounge chair, covered it with thick soft cushions, and moved Su Mu to the yard to bask in the sun.

    The dressing changes were changed from the planned once every three days to every day, and three meals a day were provided with various nourishing and nutritious soups. Under Qi Yunxi's careful care, Su Mu's injury improved significantly in less than ten days.

    Although he is still unable to get out of bed and move around freely, he can still move his hands and feet, such as holding a cup and drinking tea. He can do it by himself, and there is no need for others to do it for him.

    At this moment, Su Mu was in a bright mood, lying on the lazy chair, sipping tea leisurely, looking at the clouds in the sky, and admiring the plants and trees in the courtyard.

    The sunlight leaks from between the branches and leaves of the mulberry tree, spreading warmth on the body. The wind is also soft, and the fresh air wrapped in flowers, grass and soil blows over the cheeks one after another.

    Qi Yunxi took out a brand new quilt from the house and placed it on the clothesline. He unfolded it, smoothed it, and patted it twice through the quilt with neat and focused movements.

    Afterwards, she went to the well, rolled up her sleeves to fetch water, carried a wooden bucket and a rag to wipe the railings and door frames of the corridor. The sound of water was gushing, mixed with the little tune she occasionally hummed. The words could not be heard clearly, but the tune was brisk and sweet.

    After cleaning, she went to the kitchen again, carried the vegetable basket back to the well, sat down to select vegetables and wash them, her jade fingers flew around, and the dead leaves and roots fell into the bamboo basket at her feet...

    Every time he passed by the lounge chair, Qi Yunxi smiled at the man. His eyebrows and eyes were curved with the right arc, making him feel like he was taking a breath of spring breeze.

    Su Mu looked at her busy figure walking back and forth in the courtyard, full of contentment. Thoughts came to his mind. He just felt that such a life was good. Even if he did not practice cultivation in the future, it seemed good to enjoy the rest of his life like this.

    However, as soon as the thought came up, it was suppressed.

    Su Mu knows very well that strength is the foundation, and the law of the jungle is more obvious in the world of cultivation, which is far more complicated than ordinary society.

    The peace in front of me is short-lived, and there is also luck and luck.

    Li Gou's life, the whip of the Law Enforcement Palace, Nie Wuji's favor, Lin Yushan's hasty escape... one wrong move, and the shade above the head will change hands today.

    He picked up the tea cup and took a sip. His eyes crossed the courtyard wall and fell on the stacked peaks of the Qingyun Mountains in the distance. The mountain was still the same mountain and the clouds were still the same clouds. He was just resting temporarily under the shade of the trees. After resting enough, he had to move forward, all the way forward.

    Unknowingly, the setting sun shone slantingly, and the sunset covered the courtyard with a layer of golden gauze. The shadow of the mulberry tree was stretched very long, all the way to the steps of the corridor.

    The sound of slight footsteps was heard, and a tall and burly figure appeared on the corridor.

    Su Mu turned his head and looked away, a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, and said, "Here he comes."

    Chu Yang glanced around but didn't see Qi Yunxi, and his body swayed twice before he was in front of him.

    He waved his hand and moved the small wooden stool next to the well to the reclining chair and sat down. He asked casually: "Junior Sister Qi is out?"

    Su Mu tilted his head and said, "It's inside."

    Chu Yang nodded slightly, picked up an empty cup from the plate on the table, and poured a cup of spiritual tea. He held it in his hand but did not drink it. He just slowly turned the cup around.

    Su Mu knew him so well, he blinked and asked, "What's the matter with hesitation?"

    Chu Yang glanced towards the inner room, waved his hand to put up an isolation shield, and then said, "Sister Nan Chu will leave tomorrow morning."

    Su Mu was startled, nodded slightly and said, "She told me about leaving the clan and asked you to be a lobbyist?"

    Chu Yang looked at the other person's face, hesitantly considered his words, and said, "Brother, I don't need to say more about Sister Nan Chu's feelings for you. You also know her very well and can definitely trust her. You two are the best match, why don't you keep her?"

    Without waiting for a response, he continued: "The situation is very good now. This house is big enough, and it doesn't matter if more than one person lives in it. I'll go to Sister Nan Chu and ask her to be a concubine. I think she can accept it if she gets angry and complains. As for Junior Sister Qi, she has a softer temper and is interested in you, so she shouldn't refuse."
title_en: Chapter 26 No one can have an easy time!
